description.text:
Artists Craig Redman & Karl Maier, famous for their fun, bold and colourful designs, have once again transformed Montgomery Square with their exciting minigolf course. The course includes joyful novelty features with a design orientated approach making it a truly one-of-a-kind course!

Our picture-perfect minigolf installation is the ideal place to enjoy a day out with the kids or enter into some healthy competition with colleagues.

Its free to play, so come and see our event stewards who can provide you with clubs and balls to play. The perfect activity for all ages and abilities to enjoy.

Note, you may find Minigolf closed in inclement weather.

Corporate Hire

Is your company looking for somewhere to host your next team building session or celebrate a success?

Minigolf by Craig & Karl is now available for corporate hire 10am-12noon or 6-8pm.
